scripts.server:dev: cd ui && bun run build && cd .. && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo run -p cv-web --bin cinevault-server -- --ui ui/dist
scripts.server:build: cd ui && bun run build && cd .. && PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo build --release -p cv-web --bin cinevault-server
scripts.server:image: bun run server:image:build && docker build -t cinevault-server:local .
scripts.server:image:build: docker build --target rust-builder -t cinevault-server:rust-builder . && docker build --target ui-builder -t cinevault-server:ui-builder .
